home.eyebrow: An open scientific journal for young researchers

home.title: Write, check and publish your research article.
home.lead: Students and young researchers learn to write papers, edit their text and check facts with Xorazmiy AI, then go through peer review and publish. Every article gets its own page optimised for Google.
home.leadMobile: Learn, check with Xorazmiy AI, pass peer review and publish.
home.aiTitle: A research assistant by your side while you write
home.aiLead: Teaches you to write, edits your text, finds international sources and independently checks every fact online.

writing.title: Writing help
writing.text: Shapes the topic, research question and outline. Explains what each section should contain.

edit.title: Editing
edit.text: Spelling, style and academic language. Every change comes with a reason — you accept or reject it.

sources.title: International sources
sources.text: Finds papers, reports and statistics on your topic, with a ready-made citation.

factcheck.title: Fact checking
factcheck.text: Checks every claim online: correct, incorrect or needs a source — with the source.

home.academyTitle: Learn to write a paper from scratch
home.academyLead: Short lessons, a ready-made template and sample papers. Practise with Xorazmiy AI after every lesson.

originality.title: Originality check
originality.text: Your text is checked for similarity before submission.

profile.title: Author profile and certificate
profile.text: All your papers on one page, with a QR-coded publication certificate.

contests.title: Contests and grants
contests.text: “Best student paper of the year” and sponsor contests.

ranking.title: University ranking
ranking.text: Which universities’ students publish the most.

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.text: Updates on article status, review comments and new issues.

mentors.title: Research mentors
mentors.text: Advice from experienced scholars on the editorial board.
